title: Semantic version comparator with prerelease rules
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag build metadata being parsed but unused, or numeric identifiers ranking below alphanumeric ones. Both are semver 2.0.0 rules stated in the contract: build metadata must not affect precedence, and numeric prerelease identifiers have lower precedence than alphanumeric ones.
